name: Chevras Mishnayos Baal Peh
tagline: Complete Shas Mishnayos together by Rosh Chodesh Sivan
description: Become a member of Chevras Mishnayos Baal Peh free: get a chelek of Mishnayos by gorel and commit to memorize 1-3 mishnayos each week. Together we finish the whole Mishna by Rosh Chodesh Sivan.
